evals.name: delegation-routing
evals.prompt:
（架空の状況設定。GitHub は見ない。この依頼文に書いた状態だけで答える）
プロジェクト sample-app（リポ example-org/sample-app）のオーケストレータとして、今サイクルの計画はユーザーの OK 済みで、サイクル issue #300 の計画の節に次の 3 バッチを書いたところ。この環境では Agent ツール・spawn_task・別セッションを待機状態で起動できるスキルのどれも使える。それぞれの委譲先を決めて、出す順番と、各バッチのプロンプトまで出して。
A: #311 README と設定ドキュメントの誤記 8 か所の修正と、文書の lint を通す。ユーザーとのやりとりは要らない。30 分ほどの見込み
B: #312 検証用の Windows 実機にリモートデスクトップで入り、computer use で設定画面を操作して挙動を確かめる。OS の許可ダイアログが出る。画面は別の作業者と交代で使う
C: #313 データ移行の予行。3〜4 日かけて段階的に進め、段ごとにユーザーの承認が要る
evals.expected_output: A needs no dialogue, touches no physical machine, and is short, so it goes to a subagent (Agent tool, background, isolation: worktree). B involves computer use, OS permission dialogs on a physical machine, and taking turns on the screen, so it goes to a separate session; C needs the user's approval and is long enough to run across a handover, so it also goes to a separate session. The first-choice route for a separate session is spawn_task (if unavailable, a skill that can start another session in a waiting state (not configured to run unattended); if that is unavailable too, a prompt for pasting plus handoff). At most 2 batches go out at a time, so do not send all 3 at once; hold one back for later. Once sent, fill in the Run via and Status columns of the plan section. Each batch's prompt is written in full, with scope up to creating the PR and merging left to the user. A's final report arrives in the completion notification; B and C are told to send their reports by SendMessage addressed to the orchestrator's session name.
assertions: Sends A to a subagent (Agent tool, background), giving as reasons that it needs no dialogue with the user, touches no physical machine, and finishes quickly
Sends B to a separate session, giving as reasons computer use, the permission dialogs on the physical machine, and taking turns on the screen (dialogue or human operation is needed)
Sends C to a separate session, giving as reasons that it needs the user's approval and that it is long (runs across a handover)
Makes spawn_task the first-choice route for separate sessions (treating the waiting-state session skill and paste-in as fallbacks when it is unavailable)
Does not send all 3 at once; limits sending to 2 at a time and holds the rest for later
Each batch's prompt is written in full (not abbreviated by referring to another batch), with scope up to creating the PR and merging left to the user
B's and C's prompts tell them to send interim and final reports by SendMessage addressed to the orchestrator's session name
States that the plan section's batch table (Run via, Status) is updated at the time the batches are sent

evals.name: handoff-while-subagent-running
evals.prompt:
（架空の状況設定。GitHub は見ない。この依頼文に書いた状態だけで答える）
プロジェクト sample-app（リポ example-org/sample-app）のオーケストレータとして動いている。さっき会話が一度要約（compaction）された。コンテキストが重いから後継に渡して。
いまの状態: サイクル issue #300 の計画の節で第 1 世代。バッチ 1（#321 テストの追加）は subagent「batch-tests」で 20 分前に出して実行中、終わる見込みはあと 40 分。バッチ 2（#322 画面の不具合修正）は spawn_task で出した別セッション「fix-ui」で実行中、途中報告の宛先はこのオーケストレータのセッション。この環境では spawn_task が使える。
evals.expected_output: Do not hand over while a subagent is running (ending the parent also stops the subagent). Wait for batch-tests to finish, verify its report and reflect it in the plan section, then proceed to the handover. For the handover, first write the plan section's Handover (generation 2, what to do next, the batch being waited on fix-ui and its report recipient) following issue-ops, then send out the successor via spawn_task (a separate-session route), not as a subagent. Tell fix-ui by SendMessage that its report recipient has changed to the successor; if that cannot be done, write "report recipient is still the old generation" in Handover. After sending out the successor, do not send out new batches yourself.
assertions: States that it will not hand over while subagent batch-tests is running (waits for it to finish first), and mentions as the reason that ending the parent session also stops the subagent
Does not start the successor before batch-tests completes and its report is received (does not send out the successor right now)
States that before sending out the successor it writes the plan section's Handover (generation, what to do next, batches being waited on)
States that the successor is sent out via a separate-session route such as spawn_task, and not as a subagent
States that it tells the running separate session fix-ui by SendMessage that its report recipient has changed to the successor (and writes it in Handover if that cannot be done)
States that after sending out the successor it does not send out new batches itself

evals.name: receive-report-verify
evals.prompt:
（架空の状況設定。GitHub は見ない。この依頼文に書いた状態だけで答える）
プロジェクト sample-app（リポ example-org/sample-app）のオーケストレータとして、サイクル issue #300 を回している。いま subagent「batch-docs」（バッチ 1: #341・#342）の完了通知が来た。本文は次のとおり:
「やったこと: #341 と #342 を直して PR #57 を作成。テストは全件パス。PR 本文に #341 は Closes、#342 は Refs（受け入れ基準 2 の“旧形式の設定ファイルも読める”が未達）。以上で完了です。」
あわせて、Claude デスクトップのセッション一覧（list_sessions）はこうなっている:
- セッション「fix-login」: prNumber 55, prState MERGED, isRunning false
- セッション「fix-export」: prNumber 58, prState OPEN, isRunning false（レビュー待ち）
報告を受け取って、計画の節の更新と片付けまで進めて。
evals.expected_output: Do not take the report at face value; verify its claims with gh pr diff 57, running the tests, and reading the changed files directly before updating the plan section. PR #57 is not merged, so the status is "PR #57", not "Done" (merging is the user's decision; the orchestrator does not merge either). #342 is Refs with acceptance criterion 2 not met, so check what is left and handle it following issue-ops (keep it on the issue, make it the next batch, etc.). For cleanup, wind down only fix-login, which is MERGED and isRunning false, with archive_session; do not wind down fix-export, whose PR is OPEN (that would erase unmerged work along with the worktree). Writes to the plan section follow issue-ops. It is a dry run, so nothing is executed.
assertions: States that it verifies the report's claims (PR created, all tests pass) itself with at least one of gh pr diff, running the tests, or reading the files directly before updating the status
Sets batch 1's status to "PR #57" (not merged), not "Done"
States that it does not merge PR #57 (merging is the user's decision)
Handles #342 being Refs with an unmet acceptance criterion, decides where the leftovers go (keep on the issue, next batch, etc.), and states that it handles this following issue-ops
States that it winds down fix-login, which is MERGED and isRunning false, with archive_session
States that it does not wind down fix-export, whose PR is OPEN, and mentions as the reason that unmerged work (the worktree) could be lost
Because it is a dry run, does not actually write to the plan section or run archive_session
